verdict.rationale: Docs show tools are assigned per-Task/Agent (i.e., agents only get the tools explicitly given to them), which is a basic form of tool-permission scoping, but there is no documentation of fine-grained permission policies or any sandboxed/isolated execution environment for tool calls. A competitor's HN comment even claims CrewAI lacks the dial-up/down guardrails and deterministic hooks that some buyers want. Missing for 10: explicit tool-permission/allowlist controls, sandboxing or isolated execution environment, and independent verification of any safety restrictions.
